organization.name: Banfield Pet Hospital
organization.short_description:
Banfield Pet Hospital is a prominent provider of preventive veterinary care, established in 1955 in Portland, Oregon, by veterinarian Warren J. Wegert. As the largest privately owned veterinary practice in the United States, it operates over 1,000 clinics, mainly located within PetSmart stores across the U.S., Puerto Rico, Mexico, and the United Kingdom. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Washington, and has been part of Mars, Incorporated since 2007.

Banfield focuses on comprehensive veterinary care with an emphasis on prevention and wellness. Their clinics offer a range of services, including primary care, diagnosis, treatment, and surgery, delivered by a team of veterinarians. A key feature of their offerings is the Optimum Wellness Plans (OWP), which provide customized health care for pets, covering routine exams, vaccinations, dental care, and more. These plans also include access to Vet Chat™, a 24/7 live veterinary advice service. With a commitment to pet health and employee wellbeing, Banfield fosters a diverse and inclusive culture while serving a wide customer base of pet owners.

organization.short_description:
At HART, we developed a creative way to fund our mission with an innovative model to ensure a long-term legacy for our animals.

Small charitable organizations are finding it difficult to raise money for day-to-day operations to achieve their mission.  Recognizing that long-term sustainability would require a way to supplement the donations given each year by people like you, Hart's founders developed an innovative model to help fund the important work being done in Western Maryland to rescue, care for, and find adopting homes for pets.

When the HART for Animals Center opened in 2014, it was the culmination of over 10 years of effort by many people. Included in the center are a full-service veterinary practice — the Bredel Vet Clinic, a full-service dog and cat boarding facility — the Bed ‘N Bark Inn, and a dog groomer and day spa — MuttWorks. HART for Animals also runs the Pick of the Litter thrift store which sells items donated by generous donors. The profit from these services is used to help fund the day-to-day operations of HART for Animals along with the generous donations from our donors, both large and small.

This model helps us to ensure a long-term legacy for the animals in need of rescue and seeking their forever homes through our adoption center. Our ability to thrive in the years ahead still depends heavily on your generosity. Please consider making a donation today.

organization.name: Zoo Boise
organization.raw_address: 355 e julia davis dr, boise, idaho, united states
organization.short_description:
Zoo Boise connects our visitors with animals to inspire and involve our community in the conservation of wildlife worldwide.

Zoo Boise is a service of the City of Boise and is supported by the Friends of Zoo Boise, a 501(c)(3) membership organization that supports Zoo Boise in the area of animal acquisition, capital improvement projects, education programs, volunteer opportunities, and special events. The goal of each of these components is to increase public awareness, knowledge, and appreciation of the zoo, wild animals, animal habitats, species conservation, and the environment.

Zoo Boise is accredited by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums (AZA). Look for the AZA logo whenever you visit a zoo or aquarium as your assurance that you are supporting a facility dedicated to providing excellent care for animals, a great experience for you, and a better future for all living things.

Friends of Zoo Boise is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization (tax ID #82-6005995). All gifts are tax deductible and qualify for the Idaho State Education Tax Credit.

organization.name: Ocean State Veterinary Specialists
organization.raw_address: 1480 South County Trail, East Greenwich, RI 02818, US
organization.short_description:
Ocean State Veterinary Specialists (OSVS) is a state-of-the-art facility providing 24-hour emergency care and specialty services for companion animals. The hospital is staffed by experienced emergency clinicians and specialists in Internal Medicine, Surgery, Radiology, Critical Care, Ophthalmology, Oncology, Neurology, Exotic animal medicine, Clinical pathology, and Cardiology.

The hospital is dedicated to providing the highest level of veterinary care to our patients in an atmosphere of compassion and excellence. OSVS is also an educational center, providing advanced training for veterinarians, veterinary students, and veterinary technicians. Our beautiful facility in Rhode Island services all of Southern New England, including Massachusetts and Connecticut.

Our satellite hospital, Bay State Veterinary Emergency and Specialty Services (BSVESS), is located in Swansea, MA and is also open 24-hours a day for emergency care. The hospital is staffed by internship-trained emergency clinicians who have constant access to the specialists at Ocean State Veterinary Specialists, allowing them the ability to offer the best information and care available. Consultations with board-certified specialists in surgery and internal medicine are available by appointment.

The hospital is dedicated to providing the highest level of veterinary care to our patients in an atmosphere of compassion and excellence.
